verdict.rationale: Copilot's own docs show it explains concepts in the editor, can draw on context from your repositories, and runs agents that plan and explore work. That is related to understanding a codebase, but nothing explicitly documents explaining how a codebase's architecture fits together or pointing to where to start a change. Missing for 10: explicit codebase-wide architecture explanation, documented guidance on locating entry points for changes, any hands-on or community corroboration of codebase comprehension.

support.subject: As a developer, I can understand how a codebase fits together to find where to start making changes

citations.quote: Copilot in your editor does it all, from explaining concepts and completing code
creating a shared source of truth that includes context from your docs and repositories
let them plan, explore, and execute work autonomously in the background
